document: IEC 60364-7-701 Low-voltage electrical installations, Part 7-701: Locations containing a bath or shower
edition: Edition 3.0, 2019-10 (iTeh preview contains the zone and equipment clauses; figures 2-10 not checked)
locator: clause 701.30.102; printed p. 7 (pdf page 9 of the preview file)
quote: by a vertical circumscribing virtual surface at a distance of 120 cm from the centre of the fixed shower head(s)
value: zone 0: inside a bath tub; for showers 0-10 cm above the floor within 120 cm of the fixed shower head/outlet

document: IEC 60364-7-701 Low-voltage electrical installations, Part 7-701: Locations containing a bath or shower
edition: Edition 3.0, 2019-10 (iTeh preview contains the zone and equipment clauses; figures 2-10 not checked)
locator: clause 701.30.103; printed p. 8 (pdf page 10 of the preview file)
quote: a horizontal plane lying 225 cm above the floor level below the bath tub or a horizontal plane corresponding to the highest fixed shower head
value: zone 1: bath tub footprint up to 225 cm (or the highest fixed shower head/outlet); showers: within 120 cm of the fixed head

document: IEC 60364-7-701 Low-voltage electrical installations, Part 7-701: Locations containing a bath or shower
edition: Edition 3.0, 2019-10 (iTeh preview contains the zone and equipment clauses; figures 2-10 not checked)
locator: clause 701.30.104; printed p. 8 (pdf page 10 of the preview file)
quote: the parallel vertical virtual surface at a distance of 60 cm from the zone 1 border
value: zone 2 (bath tub only): 60 cm beyond zone 1, up to 225 cm; for showers there is no zone 2

document: IEC 60364-7-701 Low-voltage electrical installations, Part 7-701: Locations containing a bath or shower
edition: Edition 3.0, 2019-10 (iTeh preview contains the zone and equipment clauses; figures 2-10 not checked)
locator: clause 701.415.1.101; printed p. 9 (pdf page 11 of the preview file)
quote: additional protection by the use of one or more RCDs having a rated residual operating current not exceeding 30 mA shall be provided for: - circuits serving the location containing a bath tub and/or a shower;
value: 30 mA RCD for circuits serving the bath/shower location and circuits passing through zones 1/2 (SELV/PELV and electrical separation excepted)

document: IEC 60364-7-701 Low-voltage electrical installations, Part 7-701: Locations containing a bath or shower
edition: Edition 3.0, 2019-10 (iTeh preview contains the zone and equipment clauses; figures 2-10 not checked)
locator: clause 701.512.2.4.101.4; printed p. 11 (pdf page 13 of the preview file)
quote: socket-outlets, having a degree of protection of at least IPX4, of circuits protected by SELV or PELV with the source of supply installed outside zones 0 and 1;
value: zone 2 sockets only SELV/PELV with the source outside zones 0-1, IPX4; shaver supply units per IEC 61558-2-5 allowed

document: IEC 60364-7-701 Low-voltage electrical installations, Part 7-701: Locations containing a bath or shower

quote: socket-outlets of circuits protected by SELV or PELV with a rated voltage not exceeding 25 V AC or 60 V DC, with the source of supply installed outside zones 0 and 1;
